prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Choose Your New Desktop Companion", "Select a ready-to-go pet preset or create a custom companion tailored to your desktop background."]
1: ["How to Interact with Your Pet", "Your pet lives directly on your wallpaper. Right-click anytime for controls, dragging, and settings.", "Right-click pet for menu options. Click and drag to reposition on screen."]
2: ["Ensure high contrast against your desktop background for optimal pet rendering."]
3: []
4: ["Review Your Adoption Certificate", "Confirm your desktop pet's details and nickname before creating their desktop home."]
5: ["Generating Desktop Pet Assets...", "If your pet doesn't appear automatically when complete, check your system tray icon."]
6: ["Sign in with your registered account to restore your previously adopted desktop pets."]
7: ["Your pet is now active! Look for the pet icon in your taskbar if you ever lose track of it."]
8: ["Select Your Onboarding Path", "Choose a fast preset companion or spend a few moments building a fully custom pet."]
9: ["Welcome to Your Interactive Desktop Pet", "Your companion stays on your screen while you work. Right-click them anytime to manage, hide, or chat."]
